```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(glue)
library(ggridges)

cache_dir <- "gp_cache"
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

imputed_dirs <- c("imputed/c1", "imputed/c2", "imputed/c3", "imputed/cX")
```

## Data Discovery

```{r discover-files, cache=TRUE}
info_files <- list.files(imputed_dirs, pattern = "\\.info\\.gz$",
                         recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

manifest <- tibble(
  file = info_files,
  chr_raw = str_extract(basename(info_files), "\\d+|X|Y|MT"),
  chr = fct_inorder(chr_raw)
) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(chr_raw), chr_raw)

n_chr <- nrow(manifest)
n_chr
```

## Load and Cache Per-Chromosome

```{r load-and-cache, cache=FALSE}
process_info <- function(file, chr) {
  cache_file <- file.path(cache_dir, glue("info_chr_{chr}.rds"))
  if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
    return(readRDS(cache_file))
  }

  dat <- fread(file, select = c("SNP", "MAF", "Rsq"))

  pos <- as.numeric(str_extract(dat$SNP, "(?<=:)\\d+"))
  if (anyNA(pos)) {
    pos <- seq_len(nrow(dat))
  }

  result <- tibble(
    chr = chr,
    pos = pos,
    maf = dat$MAF,
    rsq = dat$Rsq
  )

  saveRDS(result, cache_file)
  result
}

all_data <- map2_dfr(manifest$file, manifest$chr, process_info) %>%
  mutate(
    chr = fct_inorder(chr),
    maf_bin = cut(maf, breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.01), include.lowest = TRUE)
  )

saveRDS(all_data, file.path(cache_dir, "all_data.rds"))
nrow(all_data)
```

## Per-Chromosome R² Histograms

```{r rsq-histograms, cache=TRUE, dependson="load-and-cache"}
all_data <- readRDS(file.path(cache_dir, "all_data.rds"))

ggplot(all_data, aes(x = rsq)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.02, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~chr, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Imputation Quality (R²) per Chromosome",
    x = expression(Imputation~R^2),
    y = "Variant Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

## Smoothed R² Across Each Chromosome

```{r rsq-smoothed, cache=TRUE, dependson="load-and-cache"}
all_data <- readRDS(file.path(cache_dir, "all_data.rds"))

chr_lens <- all_data %>%
  group_by(chr) %>%
  summarise(chr_len = max(pos, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(chr_mid = chr_len / 2)

all_data %>%
  sample_frac(0.1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pos / 1e6, y = rsq)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.05, alpha = 0.1, color = "grey40") +
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, color = "steelblue", fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.2, span = 0.05) +
  facet_wrap(~chr, scales = "free_x", ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "R² Trend Across Each Chromosome",
    x = "Position (Mb)",
    y = expression(Imputation~R^2)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

## Genome-Wide Smoothed R² (Manhattan Style)

```{r rsq-manhattan, cache=TRUE, dependson="load-and-cache"}
all_data <- readRDS(file.path(cache_dir, "all_data.rds"))

max_pos <- all_data %>%
  group_by(chr) %>%
  summarise(chr_max = max(pos, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(
    offset = lag(cumsum(chr_max), default = 0),
    offset = ifelse(is.na(offset), 0, offset)
  )

chr_colors <- rep(c("navy", "grey60"), 13)

gwas_data <- all_data %>%
  left_join(max_pos, by = "chr") %>%
  mutate(pos_gws = pos + offset)

chrom_ticks <- max_pos %>%
  mutate(mid = offset + chr_max / 2)

gwas_data %>%
  sample_frac(0.1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pos_gws, y = rsq, color = chr)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), se = TRUE, color = "darkred", fill = "darkred",
              alpha = 0.15, span = 0.02, size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = chr_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = chrom_ticks$mid,
                     labels = chrom_ticks$chr) +
  labs(
    title = "Genome-Wide R²",
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = expression(Imputation~R^2)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())
```

## R² vs MAF

```{r rsq-vs-maf, cache=TRUE, dependson="load-and-cache"}
all_data <- readRDS(file.path(cache_dir, "all_data.rds"))

all_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = maf, y = rsq)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 80) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", labels = scales::comma) +
  facet_wrap(~chr, ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "R² vs Minor Allele Frequency",
    x = "MAF",
    y = expression(Imputation~R^2),
    fill = "Variant\nCount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

all_data %>%
  mutate(maf_bin = cut(maf, breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.01), include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(maf_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rsq = mean(rsq, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rsq = median(rsq, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = maf_bin)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = median_rsq, ymax = mean_rsq, group = 1),
              fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_rsq, group = 1, color = "Mean"), size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median_rsq, group = 1, color = "Median"), size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Mean = "steelblue", Median = "darkorange")) +
  labs(
    title = "R² by MAF Bin (Genome-Wide)",
    x = "MAF Bin",
    y = expression(Imputation~R^2),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Cumulative INFO Threshold

```{r cumulative-info, cache=TRUE, dependson="load-and-cache"}
all_data <- readRDS(file.path(cache_dir, "all_data.rds"))

all_data %>%
  group_by(chr) %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    gt_03 = mean(rsq > 0.3, na.rm = TRUE),
    gt_05 = mean(rsq > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    gt_08 = mean(rsq > 0.8, na.rm = TRUE),
    gt_09 = mean(rsq > 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(chr, total), names_to = "threshold", values_to = "prop") %>%
  mutate(threshold = str_replace(threshold, "gt_0", "R² > 0.")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chr, y = prop, fill = threshold)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Variants Above R² Thresholds",
    x = "Chromosome", y = "Proportion of Variants", fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Imputation Yield

```{r imputation-yield, cache=TRUE}
pvar_files <- list.files("data", pattern = "^temp_raw_chr.*\\.pvar$", full.names = TRUE)
pre_counts <- tibble()
if (length(pvar_files) > 0) {
  pre_counts <- map_dfr(pvar_files, ~{
    chr <- str_extract(basename(.x), "\\d+|X|Y|MT")
    n <- as.numeric(str_extract(system(glue("bcftools view --no-header {.x} | wc -l"),
                                       intern = TRUE), "\\d+"))
    tibble(chr = chr, pre = n)
  })
}

yield_file <- file.path(cache_dir, "imputation_yield.csv.gz")
if (file.exists(yield_file)) {
  yield <- read_csv(yield_file, col_types = cols())

  yield_plot <- yield %>%
    { if (nrow(pre_counts) > 0) left_join(., pre_counts, by = "chr") else . } %>%
    mutate(chr = fct_inorder(chr))

  p <- yield_plot %>%
    { if ("pre" %in% names(.)) {
        select(., chr, pre, total, gt_03, gt_05) %>%
          pivot_longer(-chr, names_to = "metric", values_to = "count") %>%
          mutate(metric = recode(metric, pre = "Genotyped", total = "Imputed (all)",
                                 gt_03 = "Imputed (R² > 0.3)", gt_05 = "Imputed (R² > 0.5)"))
      } else {
        select(., chr, total, gt_03, gt_05) %>%
          pivot_longer(-chr, names_to = "metric", values_to = "count") %>%
          mutate(metric = recode(metric, total = "Imputed (all)",
                                 gt_03 = "Imputed (R² > 0.3)", gt_05 = "Imputed (R² > 0.5)"))
      }
    }

  ggplot(p, aes(x = chr, y = count / 1e6, fill = metric)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.85) +
    labs(
      title = "Imputation Yield per Chromosome",
      x = "Chromosome", y = "Variants (millions)", fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
} else {
  cat("Run 26-aggregate_gp.SLURM first to generate imputation_yield.csv.gz")
}
```

## Call Rate vs R²

```{r call-rate-vs-rsq, cache=TRUE}
cr_file <- file.path(cache_dir, "call_rate_by_ancestry.csv.gz")
if (file.exists(cr_file)) {
  cr <- read_csv(cr_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
    mutate(maf_bin = cut(maf, c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE))

  ggplot(cr, aes(x = rsq, y = call_rate)) +
    geom_hex(bins = 60) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", labels = scales::comma) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ancestry) +
    labs(
      title = "Empirical Call Rate vs Imputation R² by Ancestry",
      subtitle = "Rare imputed variants (MAF < 0.1); call rate = proportion of samples with max(GP) > 0.9",
      x = expression(Imputation~R^2), y = "Empirical Call Rate", fill = "Variants"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

  cr %>%
    group_by(ancestry, maf_bin) %>%
    summarise(mean_call = mean(call_rate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = maf_bin, y = mean_call, color = ancestry, group = ancestry)) +
    geom_line(size = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    labs(
      title = "Mean Call Rate by MAF Bin and Ancestry",
      x = "MAF Bin", y = "Mean Call Rate", color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
} else {
  cat("Run GP precomputation + aggregation first")
}
```

## Per-Sample Confident Rare Variant Calls

```{r per-sample-confident, cache=TRUE}
per_sample <- read_csv(file.path(cache_dir, "per_sample_maxgp.csv.gz"), col_types = cols())

per_sample %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_confident, fill = ancestry)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 100, alpha = 0.75, color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ancestry, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Per-Sample Count of Confident Rare Variant Calls",
    subtitle = "Variants with max(GP) > 0.9",
    x = "Number of Confident Rare Variants", y = "Sample Count", fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

per_sample %>%
  arrange(ancestry, n_confident) %>%
  group_by(ancestry) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number(), pct = rank / max(rank)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_confident, y = pct, color = ancestry)) +
  geom_step(size = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Distribution of Confident Rare Variant Calls",
    x = "Number of Confident Rare Variants",
    y = "Percentile", color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

## Genotype Posterior Probability (GP) — Rare Variants
```

```{r gp-load}
per_sample <- read_csv(file.path(cache_dir, "per_sample_maxgp.csv.gz"),
                       col_types = cols())
hist_bins  <- read_csv(file.path(cache_dir, "histogram_bins.csv.gz"),
                       col_types = cols())

ridge_raw <- read_csv(file.path(cache_dir, "ridge_samples.csv.gz"),
                      col_types = cols()) %>%
  mutate(chromosome = fct_inorder(chromosome))
```

### Average max(GP) per Individual

```{r gp-outliers, cache=TRUE}
outliers <- per_sample %>%
  group_by(ancestry) %>%
  mutate(
    z = (avg_maxgp - mean(avg_maxgp, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(avg_maxgp, na.rm = TRUE),
    flag = z < -3
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

n_flagged <- sum(outliers$flag)

ggplot(outliers, aes(x = reorder(sample_pos, avg_maxgp), y = avg_maxgp,
                     color = ancestry)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = filter(outliers, flag), size = 2, shape = 8, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Per-Sample Mean max(GP) for Rare Variants",
    subtitle = sprintf("Red stars: |z| > 3 (%d flagged)", n_flagged),
    x = "Sample (ordered by mean max GP)",
    y = "Average max(GP)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

outliers %>%
  mutate(flag_label = ifelse(flag, "Flagged", "OK")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_maxgp, fill = flag_label)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.005, alpha = 0.75, color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ancestry, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(OK = "steelblue", Flagged = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Per-Sample Mean max(GP) by Ancestry",
    x = "Average max(GP)",
    y = "Sample Count",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

### Histogram of max(GP) by Ancestry

```{r gp-histograms, cache=TRUE}
hist_bins <- hist_bins %>%
  mutate(bin_center = (bin - 0.5) / 50)

ggplot(hist_bins, aes(x = bin_center, y = count, fill = ancestry)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.5, position = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ancestry, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "max(GP) Distribution by Ancestry — All Rare Variants",
    x = "max(GP)",
    y = "Count (variant-samples)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Ridge Plot of max(GP) by Chromosome

```{r gp-ridges, cache=TRUE}
ridge_raw %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = maxgp, y = chromosome, fill = ancestry)) +
  ggridges::geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.3, scale = 1.5, rel_min_height = 0.005) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    title = "max(GP) Density by Chromosome and Ancestry",
    x = "max(GP)",
    y = "Chromosome"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

ridge_raw %>%
  group_by(chromosome, ancestry) %>%
  summarise(median_gp = median(maxgp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chromosome, y = median_gp, color = ancestry, group = ancestry)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Median max(GP) per Chromosome by Ancestry",
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = "Median max(GP)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
